Safety 
Precautions
CB must be
 isolated and proper earthing at the two sides of CBn is required.
Interrupt
 remote control and motor circuits (this achieved by receiving the multi-pin
 plug at the left hand side at the operating mechanism)
Switch breaker
 ON and OFF manually in order to discharge the closing and springs.
Tools and Equipments
Safety equipment "belt,
 shoes,...,etc".
Work to be carried out
Densimeter :-
 reduce the pressure and determine the operating point. Compare value with
 that of the gas pressure diagram if the specified tolerance is exceeded
 reset densimeter or replace
Gas moisture
 :- measure the moisture content of sf6 gas. If the moisture content of sf6
 gas is too high open-up the circuit breaker and replace the adsorber.
Prepare new densimeter 
 and seal gasket (10),
Unscrew cable 
 connection,
Unscrew the 4 M8 
 mounting with an Allen wrech,
Remove densimeter,
Remove seal gasket 
 (10).
Insert new seal gasket (10),
For assembly, proceed in reverse order of 
 disassembly,
Check gas pressure and correct adjustment if 
 necessary
